cases.reason: Radii clamp independently to half the rectangle dimensions; a lone rx supplies ry. Reference is the specified equivalent arc path.
Ellipse and circle outlines equal four quarter elliptical arcs, closed from the positive x-axis.
Relative coordinates, closepath current-point reset, H/V and reflected S/T controls expand to the explicit absolute path.
xMidYMid meet maps viewBox (10,20,20,20) into 72x40 with scale 2 and horizontal letterboxing.
xMidYMid slice uses scale 4 and y translation -100; content extends past and is clipped by the output viewport.
none maps x by 4 and y by 2 independently, subtracting the nonzero viewBox origin.
Same-direction nested contours fill under nonzero but make a hole under evenodd; reversing the inner contour gives the equivalent nonzero hole.
Width-8 right-angle miter, bevel and round joins equal their explicit outline polygons and quarter-circle arc.

tolerance.reason: Opaque geometry only: exact opaque/transparent samples, bounded differences only where both samples have partial alpha. Vector round outlines use 0.0625px chords, equivalent cubic paths use 0.25px flattening; ceil((0.0625+0.25)*255)=80 bounds the coverage allowance rather than pinning observed pixels. SVG2 conform.html#ConformingSVGViewers permits one-device-pixel geometric error. Observed differences are confined to the round corner.

cases.reason: Butt caps stop at endpoints; square caps extend half-width; round caps form semicircles of radius half-width.

cases.reason: An 8-on/4-off pattern with offset 4 begins halfway through a dash; the five nonempty butt-capped spans equal these rectangles.
Overlapping opaque children composite into an isolated group before group opacity applies, so overlap is no darker than the union.
Inherited currentColor paint resolves against each element's computed color, including descendant overrides.
Visibility is inherited and descendants can restore visible; display none excludes the whole subtree despite descendant display/visibility overrides.
Defs descendants are not directly rendered, even with display inline; the unrelated visible rectangle remains.
Mathematically known 4x4 literal RGBA: transparent border and opaque red 2x2 center at integer pixel boundaries. The PNG contains exactly those samples, not output from a browser or rasterizer.
